requestedChange: Replace whole-field groundcover submission with coarse spatial batching, analytic conservative bounds, and frustum culling while preserving Round 43 fade and hysteresis.

game.boundSource: generated per-slot anchor envelopes with conservative geometry and wind padding

tests.detail: pre-tile residence seed 0 must contain only wood roof surfaces (actual tile surfaces: 2)

comparisonToRound43.builderInterpretation: The requested batching implementation is a severe regression on the measured route. It adds submission variability without reducing the median triangle load and produces a GPU-heavy settlement tail.

visualInspection.fadeContinuity: The accepted coverage fade remains continuous through matched frames 0276-0279.
visualInspection.artifact: Red triangular surface artifacts are visible in the Round 44 matched frames. This report does not assign causality.

residualRisks: The implementation creates up to 108 groundcover batch mesh objects and can reach 90 total scene draw calls in retained frames.
Median triangles are 6528 higher than Round 43 and some retained frames reach 746221 triangles.
The browser run proves the current batch granularity and buffer layout do not achieve the intended off-view submission reduction.
The visual artifact must be separated from concurrent shared-worktree residence/roof changes before attribution.
